Allah charges no soul beyond its capacity, and the believers pray not to be blamed for forgetting or erring, nor burdened beyond their ability, but pardoned, forgiven and given victory.
Those of understanding pray that their hearts not deviate after guidance and that Allah grant them mercy.
Those who fear Allah pray, saying they have believed and asking Allah to forgive their sins and protect them from the punishment of the Fire.
Those of understanding remember Allah, reflect on creation and pray for protection from the Fire, forgiveness and to die with the righteous; their Lord answers that no work is lost.
Call upon your Lord humbly and privately, in fear and aspiration, and cause no corruption on earth; Allah's mercy is near to the doers of good.
Pray for a sound entrance and exit and a supporting authority, and declare that truth has come and falsehood, bound to vanish, has gone.
The Prophet asks not to be placed among the wrongdoers, is told to repel evil with what is best, and seeks refuge in his Lord from the devils.
The Prophet is told to ask his Lord for forgiveness and mercy, for He is the best of the merciful.
The Prophet is told to say his Lord would not care for people but for their supplication, warning Makkah's deniers that their denial will cling to them.
The Prophet calls on Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth and Knower of the unseen and witnessed, to judge between His servants in their differences.
Your Lord says to call upon Him and He will respond, and those too proud to worship Him will enter Hell in disgrace.
Seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of His creation, of settling darkness, of those who blow on knots, and of the envier when he envies.
Seek refuge in the Lord, Sovereign and God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into people's breasts, from among jinn and mankind.
